title: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum

entities.name: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
entities.description: The Zendikar block novel by Robert B. Wintermute, released April 6, 2010.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A Joraga elf planeswalker who comes to Turntimber to learn climbing and hunting from the Tajuru and guides Sorin to Akoum.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A strange human who is actually a vampire planeswalker, familiar with Zendikar, who recruits Nissa to reach the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A vampire archaeomancer once enthralled to the Eldrazi, freed when the brood are killed; accompanies Sorin.

entities.name: Sutina
entities.description: Speaker of the Tajuru killed by the Eldrazi; she was the Moon Kraken's friend.

entities.name: Hiba
entities.description: Nissa's friend, killed in the Eldrazi attack.

entities.name: Khalled
entities.description: An old merfolk cartographer in Graypelt and a friend of Nissa who gives them part of the puzzle tower Tal Terig.

entities.name: Smara
entities.description: A babbling Kor woman, a "witch vessel" carrying a spirit trapped in a crystal, traveling with goblins.

entities.name: Mudheel
entities.description: A goblin who leads the group to the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Brinelin
entities.description: The Moon Kraken that rules the waters off Akoum and recognizes Sorin.

entities.name: Biss
entities.description: A vampire who leads an army of Nulls hunting "the Mortifier".

entities.name: Shir
entities.description: A vampire who leads an army of Nulls hunting "the Mortifier".

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan released by Nissa.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan released by Nissa.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan released by Nissa.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: A canopy elf tribe at Turntimber.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient titans and their brood, bound beneath Akoum.

entities.name: Keepers of Ora Ondor
entities.description: Elves who plan to sacrifice the group to nourish their sacred Kolya fruits.

entities.name: Turntimber
entities.description: The Tajuru home tree and village region where Nissa learns.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: Zendikari continent where the Eye of Ugin lies.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: Site where the Eldrazi are bound.

entities.name: Ora Ondor
entities.description: Elven settlement overtaken by Eldrazi.

entities.name: Tal Terig
entities.description: A puzzle tower, pieces of which guide the group.

entities.name: Zulaport
entities.description: Port city beyond the Piston Mountains where the group flees after a vampiric death.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane of the novel.

entities.name: Release of the Eldrazi
entities.description: The freeing of Emrakul, Kozilek and Ulamog when Nissa shatters the central hedron.

events.summary: Eldrazi attack Turntimber, killing Speaker Sutina and Hiba and destroying the village Mosscrack.
events.quote: However, Eldrazi attack, killing Speaker Sutina and Nissa's friend Hiba , and destroying Mosscrack, a village in the Tajuru home tree.

events.summary: Nissa meets Sorin and Anowon, who is freed when the brood are killed; Sorin recruits Nissa to guide him to Akoum.
events.quote: He recruits Nissa to help him reach Akoum , where the Eye of Ugin lies.

events.summary: The group visits Khalled in Graypelt for supplies and a piece of Tal Terig.
events.quote: Khalled offers what help he can, including a piece of the puzzle tower Tal Terig

events.summary: They meet Smara and her goblin companions and agree to journey together to the Eye of Ugin.
events.quote: and Sorin suggests they journey together.

events.summary: A vampiric death in Zulaport blamed on the group forces them to flee; Nissa steals a boat and summons a beast to pull it.
events.quote: Nissa steals a boat and summons a massive beast to swim the ocean and pull the boat.

events.summary: At sea Sorin reveals he is a planeswalker and that the Eldrazi titans are bound beneath Akoum, and it is his duty to keep them sealed.
events.quote: Sorin finally reveals the truth of their mission and admits he, too, is a planeswalker.

events.summary: Sorin kills a goblin to satisfy the Moon Kraken Brinelin; Nissa persuades Brinelin by telling him of Sutina's death and the return of the brood, and he guides them through the reefs.
events.quote: Saddened by the loss and alarmed by the Eldrazi’s reappearance, Brinelin relents and guides them safely through the reefs.

events.summary: The party is captured by the keepers of Ora Ondor, but the brood besiege the settlement and the group escapes as Ora Ondor falls.
events.quote: As they flee, Ora Ondor is overtaken by Eldrazi.

events.summary: Anowon kills a scout who saved them, with Sorin's permission, shocking Nissa.
events.quote: only for Anowon to kill the man with Sorin’s permission, shocking Nissa.

events.summary: Nulls led by the vampires Biss and Shir ambush the group and take Nissa prisoner; her companions rescue her.
events.quote: That night, they are ambushed by an army of Nulls led by the two vampires Biss and Shir .

events.summary: Nissa pushes Sorin to admit he is a vampire and the cause of the vanishings.
events.quote: he admits to being a vampire and the real reason so many around them have vanished during the trip.

events.summary: At the Eye of Ugin, Nissa shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment, releasing the Eldrazi titans.
events.quote: Nissa, believing the titans should be freed to return to the stars, shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment.

events.summary: The titans remain on Zendikar and Sorin abandons the plane and Nissa.
events.quote: Horrified, Sorin abandons the plane and the "foolish elf" who refused to listen

relations.note: Came to learn from them; she is a Joraga elf, not Tajuru.
relations.quote: comes to Turntimber to learn the art of climbing and hunting from the Tajuru

relations.note: Guides him to Akoum before he abandons her.
relations.quote: He recruits Nissa to help him reach Akoum
to meet Nissa’s friend, an old merfolk cartographer named Khalled
Nissa falls in battle and awakens as their prisoner.
